coder-claudecode-nvim-agents-verify-clau.description: Drive the real claudecode.nvim plugin in a real Neovim (an agent-tty terminal) while a scripted WebSocket client (scripts/ws-client.mjs) plays the Claude Code CLI over the plugin's WebSocket MCP server, and capture screen text, PNG screenshots, WebM video, JSON-RPC traffic, and file state as evidence. Use to prove a claudecode.nvim feature works end to end (openDiff accept/reject, openFile, selection tracking, :ClaudeCodeSend at-mentions, closing diffs, the Claude terminal commands, the editor-state tools, server start/stop) without the claude CLI or network. Also use it to reproduce a bug…

coder-claudecode-nvim-agents-verify-diff.description: Model-check the claudecode.nvim openDiff answer lifecycle (TLA+/TLC) against guards read from the current Lua code. Use after a change to how diffs are resolved, replaced, closed, or answered, or to how openDiff is called (lua/claudecode/diff.lua, diff_inline.lua, server/init.lua, server/client.lua, tools/init.lua, tools/open_diff.lua, tools/close_tab.lua, tools/close_all_diff_tabs.lua, the :ClaudeCodeCloseAllDiffs command in init.lua), and before trusting such a change.

coder-claudecode-nvim-agents-verify-ment.description: Model-check the claudecode.nvim @ mention queue and the WebSocket clients it sends to (TLA+/TLC) against guards read from the current Lua code. Use after a change to how @ mentions are queued, flushed, timed out, or dropped, to when a client counts as connected or ready, to how a broadcast reports its writes, or to what a stop does to the queue (lua/claudecode/init.lua send_at_mention, _broadcast_at_mention, queue_mention, schedule_mention_flush, flush_mention_queue, expire_mentions, ms_until_a_client_is_ready, report_unwritten, clear_mention_queue, process_mention_queue, M.stop, on_open and…

coder-claudecode-nvim-agents-verify-term.description: Model-check the claudecode.nvim Claude terminal lifecycle (TLA+/TLC) against guards read from the current Lua code - the native and snacks providers, the code that finds a Claude after a plugin reload, and the provider choice (lua/claudecode/terminal.lua, terminal/native.lua, terminal/snacks.lua, terminal/owned.lua, and the terminal commands and send_at_mention in init.lua). Use after a change to how the Claude terminal is started, shown, hidden, closed, adopted, or cleaned up after Claude exits, or to how terminal.lua picks a provider, and before trusting such a change.

coder-claudecode-nvim-agents-verify-ws-c.description: Model-check the claudecode.nvim WebSocket connection lifecycle (TLA+/TLC) against guards read from the current Lua code, from the TCP accept through the handshake, requests, Close frames, keepalive pings and server stop. Use after a change to lua/claudecode/server/client.lua, server/tcp.lua, server/handshake.lua, the start/stop or callback wiring in server/init.lua, or M.start/M.stop in init.lua, and before trusting such a change.
